units: <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 3:4:2">Cant. R. to III, 4</cite> (play on <he>פלצות</he>, <cite ref="Isaiah 21:4">Is. XXI, 4</cite>) <he>פה שהוא מפיץ דברי ל׳</he> the mouth which spreads words of lasciviousness; <he>ע״י שנפקו לדבר ל׳</he> because they went out for lascivious entertainment; cmp. <cite ref="L00518"><he>לֵיצָנוּתָא</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 6:4">Tosef. Sabb. VI</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 7:4">VII</cite>), 4 <he>שתהא לה ל׳</he> that she may be entertained; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 587">Yalk. Lev. 587</cite> <he>שהתחילה לצאת</he> (corr. acc.).
